desc: Ideation: established model cost = #blocks + inversions over target permutation; verified on samples; showed naive interval DP without swap costs is invalid.
Derive efficient algorithm: run-compression + O(N) DP with per-value best (dp[p] - p) for extend transitions.
Implement solution reading T test cases from stdin, printing answer per case.
Stress-test DP vs brute-force over round assignments for small N (exhaustive, length ≤ 7 over {1,2,3}); validated extend-transition inversion accounting with interleaved values.
Cross-validate label model against BFS over actual operations (length ≤ 6 over {1,2}, ≤ 5 over {1,2,3}); verified samples and edge cases (all equal→1, all distinct→N).
